static_traits.name: Li Wanting
static_traits.social_status: Has one close friend's support, but has not yet discussed the cooking-failure feelings; relationship with girlfriend tense
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no prior psychotherapy experience; no similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-Reflect and describe emotions; relatively high cooperativeness; Low mood with a tendency toward Self-doubt and focus on negative feedback

basic_info.main_problem: Because my girlfriend did not like the dessert I prepared for the three-course dinner, I feel I am a failed Chef.
basic_info.core_demands: That dinner event and the subsequent sense of failure significantly affected my self-esteem and my enjoyment of cooking, so I am seeking counseling for guidance and support.

special_situations.event: While preparing a three-course dinner for my girlfriend, she did not like the dessert
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the dessert, this key part, is not liked, then the whole meal is a failure, and I am not qualified as a Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries making more complex dishes to make up for this failure, and puts more energy into desserts in pursuit of perfection

special_situations.event: When cooking for someone important and receiving negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an important person does not like a dish, it means I am not good enough, and it will damage the relationship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles her efforts and pursues perfection to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Her not liking the dessert equals negating me, this will destroy my confidence in cooking

special_situations.event: Receiving positive and negative feedback at the same time (appetizers and main course liked, but dessert not liked)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If negative evaluation appears, positive feedback does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or negating positive feedback, repeatedly thinking about the negative review
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That negative review is the key point, the other good things are not important

special_situations.event: Persistent worry when preparing desserts due to the last experience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the dessert is not perfect enough, it proves I am not good at desserts and do not deserve to be a Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids expressing feelings of failure to friends, tries to prove oneself with more complex dishes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This dessert will very likely fail again, I will mess up again

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and accepted by the important other (girlfriend), and to gain affirmation through cooking
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected, being negated, and being seen as not good enough
defense_goal: Avoiding failure and negation through doubled effort and perfectionism, to maintain self-esteem and relational security

object_relations.self_representation: Not good enough, an easily negated person being evaluated
object_relations.object_representation: The key other (girlfriend) as a picky judge, whose feedback determines my worth

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing negative feedback or being reminded of the detail that the dessert was 'not liked'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating negation of the dish with negation of the whole person (transference: giving evaluation the power to determine self-worth)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Validating their emotions in a gentle, Empathy tone; using open-ended questions to Guide them to concretize facts and evidence; highlighting the overlooked positive side and distinguishing 'event evaluation' from 'self-worth'.

manifestations: Cooking was once a source of stress relief and achievement, but became pressure and Self-doubt after the event
Places others' evaluation at the core; her own intrinsic meaning and enjoyment of cooking are shaken

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Believing 'dessert should be the highlight', one imperfect spot is seen as overall failure
Measures self-worth by others' standards rather than one's own experience

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Ignores positive feedback; over-focuses on negative reviews
Worrying about being seen as weak and not sharing feelings with supportive friends
Constantly Self-doubting and lowering cooking motivation

positive_force: Having experienced creativity and achievement in cooking
Self-taught with sustained motivation and experience to improve
Received positive feedback on appetizers and main courses
Willing to seek counseling and change thinking patterns
Having supportive friends as potential resources
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralizing, mental-filtering, and negating-the-positive thought patterns
Self-worth highly dependent on others' evaluations
Lowered motivation and avoiding sharing for fear of failure
High pressure from pursuing perfection in front of important others

target_behavior.behavior: Developing Anxiety and Self-doubt in cooking (especially dessert) situations, and lowering cooking motivation
antecedent: Preparing meals for the important person (girlfriend)
Thinking of or recalling the episode of the girlfriend not liking the dessert
When preparing desserts or facing dessert evaluations
The situation of receiving positive and negative feedback at once
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing one negative feedback and overgeneralizing it into overall failure, and taking others' evaluations as the core standard determining self-worth
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential failure and negation (negative emotions and relationship risks), trying to maintain self-esteem through avoidance or perfectionism
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, reduced cooking motivation, Relationship tension, declining daily Life enjoyment
